answer: Bind each identity to one hashed boarding pass from a flight already flown, checked against the airline's record; the platform stores only the hash, and a duplicate is refused. A sybil farmer then faces a tundra of cost: every fake needs a separate paid seat actually flown, not a script spinning up accounts at a wharf of cheap logins. A nebula of a thousand fakes would need a thousand real trips. Limit: honest agents who never fly are locked out, and cheap short-haul tickets set a low price floor, so pair this with other checks.
